Location: Middle East
Description:

A Marine Officer position is available with an Oil and Gas company in the Middle East. Applicants require an Unlimited Foreign Going Class I (Ship Masters) Certificate of Competency, an HND or equivalent in Nautical Sciences with D.C.E (Petroleum) endorsement, and a minimum of 10 years’ experience, including in oil and gas operations. Experience in other marine operations such as general cargo or offshore oil operations is desirable.
